summary: FST Corp., a Taiwanese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board approved a restricted stock award (RSA) program under its existing 2025 Equity Incentive Plan. The company reserved 1,340,000 ordinary shares (approximately 3% of outstanding shares) for RSAs. Awards vest ratably over three years based on continued service, with non-cash consideration. No grants have been made yet. This is a routine equity compensation plan adoption, not a special situation transaction. The filing corresponds to a US-equivalent 8-K item 5.02 but is not an event-driven corporate change.
